Teaching

I have been teaching assistant for undergraduate and graduate courses from the Engineering, Mathematics and Physics faculty at PUC

  1. Introduction to Microlocal Analysis and Inverse Problem (graduate), Instructor: Benjamín Palacios, 2nd Semester 2023
  2. Advanced Optimization (graduate), Instructor: Cristóbal Guzmán, 1st Semester 2023
  3. Applications of PDEs and Functional Analysis to Engineering (graduate), Instructor: Federico Fuentes, 1st Semester 2023
  4. Topics in Inverse Problems (graduate), Instrutor: Carlos Sing-Long, 1st Semester 2023
    • Expert TA: Held weekly office hours, designed homework questions and final projects. Topics were distribution Theory, functional analysis, Sobolev spaces, Pseudodifferential operators, Frame Theory, Multiresolution analysis, denoising, and others. Examples of topics for projects: Radon Transform, Robust PCA, Compressed Sensing-MRI reconstruction, Phase Retrieval, and others.
  5. Scientific Computing I, Instructor: Federico Fuentes, 2nd Semester 2022
  6. Biomedical Imaging, Instructor: Carlos Sing-Long, 2nd Semester 2022
    • Expert TA: Designed final projects and prepared weekly Jupyter notebooks to teach students the different biomedical imaging modalities in Python. Topics included: basic signal processing, modern physics, X-rays, Radon transform, CT, Gammagraphy, SPECT, Acoustic and optics, MRI, and Under-sampled reconstruction in MRI.
  7. Topics in Inverse Problems (graduate), Instructor: Carlos Sing-Long, 1st Semester 2022
  8. Fourier Analysis, Instructor: Carlos Sing-Long, 2nd Semester 2021
  9. Calculus III, 1st Semester 2021
  10. Electricity and Magnetism Laboratory, Summer Semester 2021
  11. Scientific Computing I, Instructor: Thomas Führer, 1st Semester 2020
  12. Electricity and Magnetism, 1st Semester 2020
